energy_target: VASP force-consistent TOTEN, eV per cell; never silently substitute sigma0 energy

offset.objective: Mean of (E_DFT - E_model)/N over train configurations, uniform configuration weights
offset.application: E_aligned = E_model + N * delta_Al; same delta on all splits
offset.forbidden: No validation/test-fitted, phase-specific or stress offsets; no scale fit

metrics.energy: MAE/RMSE/signed mean/max absolute error per atom, raw and train-aligned
metrics.forces: MAE/RMSE/signed mean/max over Cartesian components; no offset
metrics.stress: MAE/RMSE/signed mean/max over six independent tensile-positive Voigt components xx yy zz yz xz xy, eV/A^3; no offset
metrics.grouping: Report each frozen split and each parent_id; all40 pooled is descriptive only

test_policy: User-requested frozen baseline evaluation only. Test values must not guide checkpoint choice, fine-tuning hyperparameters or sampling. Original checkpoints remain fixed; no scientific teacher selected.
limits: Pure Al32 cannot identify multielement reference shifts
A constant energy shift cannot repair PAW/functional/smearing-dependent forces, stress or state-dependent energy errors
Pretraining overlap with OMat24 not excluded; no pretraining-independent generalization claim
Local DFT convergence was qualified narrowly on two train parents, not an exact reference limit
authorization: User requested original DPA4 and GRACE checkpoint evaluation on the completed Al32 DFT dataset, including energy-zero alignment; no training or new DFT
